4452-4659-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4452-4659-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-2835-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2835-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4871-6495-6705.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
4871-6495-6705.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-3899-5708.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

851-1308-3129-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4559-5147-5491-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
4559-5147-5491-7839.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Worldwalker Helm.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1479-5033-7892.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-5033-7892.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

2757-5285-6753.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

1887-2021-2060-4772.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

5078-6766-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

101-3617-7631.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

893-1558-2048-4840.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Myr.
893-1558-2048-4840.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it and five Myr, searching your library for Myr Battlesphere and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat each turn.

4871-5231-6476-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
4871-5231-6476-7487.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Zealous Lorecaster and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Zealous Lorecaster, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1394-2060-3129-5147-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Primal Vigor.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Primal Vigor.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

1394-2060-2265-5256-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Hardened Scales.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Hardened Scales.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

2113-3459-4316-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7060-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
3259-7060-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7060-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
3259-7060-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

2173-2448-5220-7192.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-5220-7192.description:
Cast Goblin Firestarter by paying its mana cost.
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-4974-5702-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4974-5702-6633.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3088-3334-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Xenic Poltergeist
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5189-6872.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
4050-5189-6872.description:
Activate Ghave by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
When the creature token dies, Lord Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ghave.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

372-1031-3603.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1031-3603.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Invasion of Arcavios and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Invasion of Arcavios trigger.
Resolve the Invasion of Arcavios trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Invasion of Arcavios and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

4826-5003-6644-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

151-5261-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Forensic Researcher does not have summoning sickness.
151-5261-5475.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

985-5033-5078-5679.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
985-5033-5078-5679.description:
Activate a land that enters the battlefield untapped by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Kellan triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

819-1170-4074-5195-5243.notablePrerequisites:
The Reality Chip attached to any creature you control.
You have not copied a spell using Chandra this turn.
819-1170-4074-5195-5243.description:
Cast any spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Memory Lapse either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}{U}, targeting that spell.
Chandra, Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, copying Memory Lapse, targeting the original Memory Lapse.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of Memory Lapse, countering the original Memory Lapse and putting it on top of your library.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1322-3942-3982-4377.notablePrerequisites:
If Living Lore is in your graveyard, you have not played a creature spell using Karador this turn.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
1322-3942-3982-4377.description:
Cast Living Lore from your hand or graveyard by paying {3}{U}.
Living Lore enters the battlefield, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard.
Move to your combat phase, and deal combat damage with Living Lore.
Living Lore triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and cast Walk the Aeons from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

423-511-3510-4214.notablePrerequisites: Either Sporoloth Ancient or Utopia Mycon has at least three spore counters on it, with the other having at least two spore counters on it.
423-511-3510-4214.description:
Activate either Utopia Mycon or Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Life and Limb, Evolution Sage triggers, putting a spore counter on Utopia Mycon and Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.

461-2607-4141.description:
Activate Zevlor by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to copy the next spell you cast this turn that targets a single opponent for each other opponent.
Cast Blood Tribute with kicker by paying {4}{B}{B} and tapping a Vampire you control, targeting any opponent.
Zevlor triggers, copying Peer into the Abyss for each opponent.
Resolve each Peer into the Abyss, causing each opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1548-1810-1953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1548-1810-1953.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Port Razer.
Move to your combat phase.
Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token and causing all creature tokens you control to become a copy of the Port Razer token.
Deal combat damage with any Port Razer token.
The Port Razer token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

3774-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Luxior attached to Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
3774-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Because Luxior gives Devoted Druid +1/+1 for each counter on it, Devoted Druid's toughness remains unchanged.
Repeat.

2103-2334-2556.description:
With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat
